method: Release binaries built from the base and the exact candidate patch, then run in three alternating-order pairs after compilation finished. Each process executes benchmark interaction-diagnostic under /usr/bin/time -l. Other host activity is uncontrolled. Per-run and aggregate medians use nearest-rank source semantics. Darwin maximum resident set size is bytes. This compares two native implementations only, not pinned Hunk or the complete release gate.
reproduce: Build cargo build --release -p xtask at baseCommit and preserve that binary. Apply candidatePatch, rebuild and preserve the candidate binary. From the workspace root, alternate /usr/bin/time -l <binary> benchmark interaction-diagnostic in the recorded run order. Do not build or run tests concurrently.
